 Gallery: ‘Ramos plus Cisse’, ‘The derby on their mind’ – Today’s front pages in Italy 
 By Oliver Fisher - 28 October 2026, 10:00 
 AC Milan are back in front of their own fans this evening as they welcome Bologna to San Siro, hoping to make it three league wins on the spin. 
 Milan bounced back from their defeat against Bournemouth in the Europa League with a 2-0 win away at Udinese on Sunday. Now, the task is to continue to decent start in Serie A with a victory against the Rossoblu , with an eye on Saturday’s derby against Inter.

 Today’s front pages 
 Below are how the front pages in Italy ahead of another important night of midweek action, after a few games took place last night.
 La Gazzetta dello Sport:  “Milan have the derby on their mind. Against Bologna, the big names will be absent, Cissé will feature.”
 Corriere dello Sport:  “Ramos plus Cissé: Milan push forward. In pursuit of a third consecutive win. Gila, Rabiot and Moreira will not be fit in time. Modrić likely to start on the bench. Pulisic signs until 2031.” 
 QS:  “Act two with Milan against Bologna: it’s over to Jashari and Hutchinson.”
